goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.label: Product safety information reaching the company is recognised and reported within the required window, without relying on individual vigilance.
goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.measure: Proportion of inbound PSI-bearing contacts that are reported inside the regulatory window, and the count of late or missed reports found on audit.

reachability.trainable: Recognition. Staff who encounter a contact cannot report what they do not identify as product safety information in the first place — that is a knowledge and discrimination problem, and it is the part instruction can move.
not_trainable: Reporting channel friction — if the intake path is slow or unclear, trained staff still report late. Process, not instruction.
Workload and staffing — recognition under time pressure degrades regardless of how well someone was taught.
Incentive structure — where reporting is perceived to create work or risk for the reporter, training does not overcome it.
reachability.rationale: The two seeded objectives (define PSI, recognise PSI) both sit squarely on the recognition half. Naming the other three causes explicitly keeps a later audit from reading a flat reporting rate as a training failure — which is the failure mode this gate exists to prevent.

goal_ast009_psi_reported_on_time.derived_from: AST009 reference programme; the outcome implied by atom-spec §4's objectives, made explicit here for the first time.

goal_alsap_asset_safety_monitored.label: Emerging safety risks at the asset level are identified, evaluated, and communicated through a single maintained ALSAP during clinical development.
goal_alsap_asset_safety_monitored.measure: Proportion of in-scope assets with a current ALSAP (annual SMT review complete; ad hoc updates after signals, regulatory changes, or milestones), and the count of assets proceeding in development without one.

reachability.trainable: Knowing what an ALSAP is and that one exists per asset; who is in scope; and how to run the three procedure cycles the SOP names (plan development, develop/maintain/approve, analysis datasets and TLFs including protecting the blind). Those are knowledge and procedure-following problems instruction can move.
not_trainable: EDMS or SCE friction — if filing, routing, or restricted-folder access is slow, a trained ALSAP Lead still misses windows. Process, not instruction.
SMT meeting culture and schedule — alignment and review cycles fail when the forum does not meet, regardless of how well the SOP was taught.
Data quality that triggers ad hoc updates, and the regulatory changes themselves — those are inputs to the plan, not outputs of training.
Workload that compresses the 10-business-day review — training does not create calendar time.
reachability.rationale: SOP-AST-29080 exists to operationalize asset-level safety monitoring. The trainable slice is the procedure the atoms already state. Naming EDMS, SMT cadence, data quality, and workload as not-trainable keeps a later missing-ALSAP count from being read as a training failure.

goal_bw_pay_understood.label: Brunswick salaried employees understand how pay is determined — the philosophy, the factors, and base pay's place in total rewards — and know where to find their own compensation information, so that pay transparency lands as informed understanding rather than unexplained numbers.
goal_bw_pay_understood.measure: Optional employee eLearning completion and embedded check performance (SOW §5); downstream, the quality of pay conversations employees initiate — measured through the manager/HR channel the program equips separately.

reachability.trainable: Understanding. What the philosophy is, which factors set a salary, how base pay sits inside total rewards, where Workday and the Total Rewards Statement live, and that EU-specific rights exist — all knowledge and orientation, exactly what an awareness course can move.
not_trainable: Actual pay outcomes and pay equity itself — properties of the compensation structure and its administration, not of anything a learner is taught.
Trust in the fairness of pay — built or broken in real conversations with managers and in lived outcomes; the course can inform it, not produce it.
Manager conversation quality — the other half of the program (required manager course, drive two), not this optional awareness piece.
Regulatory compliance itself — a legal and process obligation Brunswick meets by disclosure practices, not by employee training.
reachability.rationale: Drafted by BPS (instructional designer) from the SOW, the client-ready LO document, and the LO revision analysis — whose 'confidence builds through practice over time' note is this same judgment made in the wild a year early, for the manager half. Ratified validated 2026-08-31 by Jake (BPS, owning instructional designer) as the working warrant for the employee-awareness build — validated here means the warrant holds for building; Brunswick client sign-off is a separate, later event and will be recorded when it happens.

goal_ast_cci_library_used.label: In-scope assets have a CCI library before IND, and disclosing parties follow it so already-public text is not redisclosed or fought as a redaction.
goal_ast_cci_library_used.measure: Count of in-scope assets with an archived FORM-AST-35734 before IND, and count of redaction/disclosure incidents that cite already-public text — not LMS completion.

reachability.trainable: Asset Leads can complete FORM-AST-35734 using GUIDE-AST-6011; disclosing parties can find and follow the FORM and know to escalate a deviation before ship; both groups connect the rule to irreversible public-domain errors and participant data in the same files.
not_trainable: Helix or Kachi trigger that a library must start between CN and IND.
Where FORM-AST-35734 is stored and how disclosing parties are informed it exists.
Public Disclosure Tracking Tool in production, including a quarterly feed that can discharge the measure.
A governing body to overrule Asset Leads who mark everything CCI.
Making every listed organization CCI-literate (that is comms).
reachability.rationale: Warranted as a partial pass on the accepted dossier doss_ast_cci_pd. Trainable slice is the QD nucleus (SOP-AST-29658 / GUIDE-AST-6011 / FORM-AST-35734) plus the living connection to already-public failures. Remainder-bin operating model is not a learning objective. validated here means the warrant holds for building, same sense as goal_bw_pay_understood 2026-08-31.
